company.name: Blair
company.shortDescription: Blair provides a platform that allows schools to finance students through Income-Share Agreements.
company.description:
Blair helps schools to be more accessible by structuring and creating sustainable ISA programs. It features ISA which allows students to attend educational programs without upfront tuition and pay back once they have a job.

It was founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that enabled schools to finance students through income-share agreements, allowing students to pay tuition based on future income.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $6,300,000, or 5.87% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,525,096 to $99,339,669, a 15.22x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (+5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
